changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Guardrail: enforce referral entity_type allowed values (ADVISOR, STAFF, APPLICANT) at DB level
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE n_referral_code_registry ADD CONSTRAINT chk_n_referral_code_registry_entity_type CHECK (entity_type IS NULL OR entity_type IN ('ADVISOR', 'STAFF', 'APPLICANT'))
